decisions.reason: Requiring the demonstration to show liquid dispensing through both spouts tests existing operation but does not change the spouts' geometry, material, orientation, or mounting configuration.
The uninterrupted liquid test and underside inspection do not change the required system-layout CAD deliverable or CAD-file retention.
The source changes the prototype demonstration criteria, not the content or status of the electrical wiring-plan deliverable.
The requested operational test neither revises component selections nor changes the BOM artifact or compatibility requirement.

Although both stations must operate for several minutes, the source specifically adds demonstration continuity, liquid-flow, and leak-inspection criteria; it does not modify the existing structural-stability or vibration requirements.
Showing liquid dispensing through both spouts does not change the platform height, footprint, cup clearance, or platform configuration.
The operational demonstration request does not resume or change the deferred measurement-ring markings.
The source concerns functional liquid testing and does not resume or modify the deferred decorative DJ-style controls.
The requested test and underside inspection do not alter or resume the deferred power-button accent-lighting requirement.
The operational-test criteria do not change the machine or support-base color scheme.
The source does not resume or modify the deferred support-base logo and lettering treatment.
The uninterrupted liquid test does not resume or change the deferred bowl accent-lighting requirement.
